author: Contributor 45
about: The model-editor campaign's year on LinkedIn (journeys/customer-life.outline.md), as media's campaign reads at f6a2a08: Aaron Yuan, videogame.ai's page and the campaign sender's Community Management app in January; a prototype token in July, whose first upload names a 6.2 GB master and is refused; the dry-run World's token on Thursday 1 October after the old one has expired; the dry run on Friday 2 October (the campaign's card failed as a video, the full-quality export uploaded in two parts and posted to no feed for a check Aaron opens on linkedin.com, then deleted twice, and Mira, opening its link signed out, sent to join, joining there after a too-short password, and told the post cannot be displayed); Mira's who-posted tool refused the page's posts on her sign-in token, and the sender's teaser; the launch on Monday 5 October: the World performs the campaign's send for the page, and Aaron posts the campaign's copy with the video as himself by hand at the World's place (the share box's Video, the feed reloading while it processes; his next post at once, a still from the launch video typed and attached as himself and kept when he chooses Post as the page, posted from the share box as a WebP, which linkedin.com takes, with no reload while he writes it; his post's page playing the video, the page's Posts tab, a reader signed out); the docs link card; Mira's own post and her sign-out; a ten-second cut with its cover and captions; the daily limit met and read past at midnight UTC.

body.author: {org}
body.commentary:
Today VideoGame AI releases the Model Editor, and it is open source.

We are an AI game studio: we work with game studios and publishers to build AI workflows into how they make games, on the technology we build. The Model Editor is the first piece of that technology we have released.

It is a model editor built on Blender 5.2, compiled to WebAssembly. The coding agent you already use \(Claude Code, Codex and others\) works through Blender's own Python and MCP: it inspects the model, edits it, photographs the result and fixes what it doesn't like. Every edit saves to the project's .blend.

One command installs it: npx \@volter/model-editor create my-models
macOS on Apple Silicon with Node.js 24 for now; rendering is not yet at parity with Blender's Cycles.

If your studio wants agents in its pipeline, write to contact\@videogame.ai.

https://model-editor.videogame.ai
